source: Development tool output observed before final release validation

findings.observed: Four team cases rejected unsupported conversation history
findings.cause: The new fixture created an empty Responses continuation exchange, which is not valid provider history
findings.resolution: Supply an actual Responses assistant message; keep production history validation strict

findings.cause: Test requeued a restored member and then exported without finishing or stopping that run
findings.resolution: Finish the continued member at an interrupted checkpoint before another export; retain stale report rejection

findings.cause: Test used settings then view instead of ToolTaskState.policy.settings
findings.resolution: Read the typed policy field; no product validation weakened

findings.observed: Foreign-task agent rejected during read-only import
findings.cause: The fixture expected restoration to handle a record already rejected by the container
findings.resolution: Use a duplicate agent ID with consistent links and an extra same-task agent to exercise restoration checks; six targeted tests passed
